panels.description: Real-time spending velocity extrapolated to an hourly rate, based on the last 5 minutes of activity. Reacts quickly to changes in usage intensity. Useful for spotting runaway agent loops or expensive operations in progress.
panels.title: Current Spend Rate ($/hr)

panels.description: Cumulative API cost in USD over the selected period across all sessions and models.
panels.title: Total API Spend

panels.description: Aggregate token count across all categories (input, output, cache reads, cache writes) over the selected period. Measures overall API throughput volume regardless of billing rate.
panels.title: Total Token Usage

panels.description: Current total lines of code in the project as of the latest data point in the selected period.
panels.title: Codebase Size (Lines)

panels.description: Real-time token consumption velocity across all token categories, based on the last 5 minutes of activity. Useful for monitoring active session intensity and detecting unusual spikes.
panels.title: Token Throughput (tokens/min)

panels.description: Number of unique Claude Code sessions that incurred API cost in the last hour. Indicates current concurrent usage activity.
panels.title: Active Sessions (1h)

panels.description: umulative time users spent actively interacting with Claude Code over the selected period. Convert to hours or minutes as needed for readability.
panels.title: Total Active User Time

panels.description: Cumulative time the Claude Code CLI was actively running over the selected period. Includes user interaction, model inference, and tool execution time.
panels.title: Total CLI Session Time

panels.description: Total input tokens processed at full base rate (not served from cache) over the selected period. A high value relative to cache read tokens may indicate poor cache utilization.
panels.title: Uncached Input Tokens

panels.description: Total tokens generated by Claude across all sessions over the selected period. Output tokens are billed at the highest per-token rate and are typically the largest cost component.
panels.title: Total Output Tokens

panels.description: Total input tokens served from prompt cache over the selected period. Billed at 0.1× the base input rate. Higher values indicate effective cache utilization and significant cost savings.
panels.title: Cache Read Tokens

panels.description: Total tokens written to prompt cache over the selected period. Billed at 2× base input rate (1-hour TTL). High values relative to cache read tokens may indicate frequent cache invalidation or many short-lived sessions.
panels.title: Cache Write Tokens

panels.description: Percentage of input served from cache (higher = better)
panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio

panels.description: Ratio of CLI active time to user active time. Values above 1 indicate time spent on model inference and tool execution. Higher values mean Claude is doing more autonomous work per unit of user interaction.
panels.title: CLI-to-User Time Ratio

panels.description: API spend over the selected period as a multiple of a $20 subscription. Values above 1.0 indicate the subscription is providing value — the higher the number, the more you're getting for your subscription dollar.
panels.title: Subscription ROI (Pro Plan)

panels.description: Total API spend divided by output tokens generated, expressed per 1K tokens. Captures the all-in cost of producing model output, including input and caching overhead. Lower is more efficient.
panels.title: Blended Cost per 1K Output Tokens

panels.description: Total API spend over the selected period divided by the current codebase size in lines. Measures spending relative to where the project stands now. Best for point-in-time efficiency assessment.
panels.title: Cost per Line of Code

panels.description: Current codebase size divided by total API spend over the selected period. Higher values indicate more code relative to spending. Uses the latest line count rather than the period average.
panels.title: Lines of Code per Dollar (Current)

panels.description: Current spending velocity extrapolated to a daily rate, based on the last 1 hour of activity. Useful for budget monitoring and spotting cost anomalies. Drops to zero during periods of inactivity.
panels.title: Projected Daily Spend

panels.description: Current spending velocity extrapolated to a 30-day monthly rate, based on the last 1 hour of activity. Highly sensitive to current activity levels — best used as a directional indicator during active sessions, not a forecast.
panels.title: Projected Monthly Spend

panels.description: Total spend over the last 24 hours divided by the number of unique sessions. Helps identify whether sessions are cost-efficient or if specific sessions are driving disproportionate spend. Note: session count includes all sessions in retention, not just those active in the last 24h.
panels.title: Average Cost per Session

panels.description: Estimated developer-hours equivalent of the codebase, based on a productivity baseline of 75 lines of code per hour. Provides a rough sense of how much human effort the project represents.
panels.title: Dev Equivalent (Hours)

panels.description: Total API spend divided by hours of active user interaction. Measures the effective hourly rate of using Claude Code. Compare against developer hourly rates to gauge cost efficiency.
panels.title: Cost per Active Hour

panels.description:
Codebase size divided by hours of active user interaction. Measures code leverage per hour of Claude Code usage.
Note: reflects total codebase size, not lines produced during the period.
panels.title: Lines of Code per Active Hour

panels.description: What your usage would cost on API pricing
panels.title: Total API Spend

panels.description: Net savings from using a $100 subscription versus pay-as-you-go API pricing. Positive values indicate money saved by the subscription. Negative values indicate the subscription costs more than equivalent API usage would.
panels.title: Subscription Savings (Max 100 Plan)

panels.description: Estimated dollar cost of cache write tokens in the last 24 hours. ⚠️ Verify the rate multiplier matches your cache TTL — use $3.75/MTok for 5-minute cache or $6.00/MTok for 1-hour cache (Sonnet 4.6).
panels.title: Cache Write Cost Sonnet (24h)

panels.description: Estimated dollar cost of uncached input tokens in the last 24 hours, billed at the standard base input rate ($3/MTok for Sonnet 4.6). Should be minimal relative to cache read costs in well-optimized sessions.
panels.title: Uncached Input Cost (24h)

panels.description: Estimated water consumption in US gallons associated with API usage over the selected period, based on approximate data center cooling requirements per token processed. Intended as an environmental awareness metric — actual impact varies by data center infrastructure.
panels.title: Water Impact (Gallons)

panels.description: Token consumption over time broken down by category — input, output, cache reads, and cache writes. Visualizes the relative volume and timing of each token type across sessions.
panels.title: Token Usage by Type

panels.description: Proportional breakdown of token consumption by Claude model over the selected period. Identifies which models are driving the most usage — useful for cost optimization since model pricing varies significantly.
panels.title: Token Usage by Model

panels.description: Breakdown of active time between user interaction and CLI process time over the selected period. The gap between CLI and user time represents time spent on model thinking, tool execution, and automated operations.
panels.title: Active Time by Type

panels.description: Total API cost broken down by Claude model over the selected period. Identifies which models are driving the most spend — useful for evaluating whether expensive model usage is justified or could be shifted to cheaper alternatives.
panels.title: Spend by Model

panels.description: Rolling 1-hour API spend broken down by Claude model. Shows when and how much each model contributes to cost over time. Useful for identifying usage patterns, peak spending periods, and model switching behavior.
panels.title: Hourly Spend by Model

panels.description: Real-time token consumption rate per minute broken down by category. Shows the live rhythm of API usage — cache reads dominate during active sessions, output tokens spike during generation, and cache writes appear when new context is added.
panels.title: Token Throughput by Type (tokens/min - log scale)

panels.description: Number of API calls per model based on cost counter value changes over a rolling 5-minute window. Shows request volume and model switching patterns in real time. Each change represents a completed API request regardless of cost magnitude.
panels.title: API Call Frequency by Model

panels.description: Total API spend in rolling 1-hour windows over time. Each bar represents the cost accumulated in the preceding hour. Visualizes spending rhythm across the day and highlights peak usage periods.
panels.title: Hourly Spend

panels.description: Total tokens consumed across all categories over a rolling 7-day window. Tracks week-over-week usage trends for capacity planning and budget forecasting.
panels.title: Weekly Token Usage

panels.description: Real-time spend rate ($/hr) plotted against a ±2 standard deviation band based on 1-hour smoothed trend. Breaches of the upper band indicate statistically unusual spending — potential runaway operations or cost anomalies.
panels.title: Spend Rate with Anomaly Bands

panels.description: Real-time per-second token consumption rate broken down by category over a 5-minute smoothing window. Shows the raw throughput signal for each token type — cache reads should consistently dominate in well-cached sessions.
panels.title: Token Rate by Type (tokens/sec)

panels.description: Real-time per-second token consumption rate broken down by Claude model. Shows which model is active and at what intensity. Reveals model switching patterns and relative throughput across models.
panels.title: Token Rate by Model (tokens/sec)

panels.description: Real-time spending velocity in dollars per hour broken down by Claude model, based on a 5-minute smoothing window. Shows which model is driving cost at any moment — useful for identifying whether expensive model usage is intentional.
panels.title: Spend Rate by Model ($/hr)

panels.description: Running total of API spend over time broken down by Claude model. Steeper slopes indicate periods of higher spending intensity.
panels.title: Cumulative Cost Over Time

panels.description: Real-time rate of lines added and removed per minute, based on a 5-minute smoothing window. High values on both indicate active refactoring. Net difference shows codebase growth or shrinkage velocity.
panels.title: Code Churn Rate (lines/min)

panels.description: Rolling 1-hour count of Git commits and pull requests. Shows development output cadence — commits indicate active coding, PRs indicate code ready for review. Zero-filled to avoid display gaps during inactive periods.
panels.title: Development Activity (Hourly)

panels.description: Rolling 1-day API spend compared against the same period 7 days prior. Shows week-over-week spending trends — consistent gaps indicate growing or declining usage patterns, sudden divergence signals anomalies.
panels.title: Daily Spend: This Week vs Last Week

panels.description: Real-time utilization rate for user interaction and CLI process, based on a 5-minute window. Values near 1.0 indicate continuous activity, near 0.0 indicate idle. The gap between CLI and user lines represents autonomous model work.
panels.title: Activity Utilization Rate

panels.description: API spend per individual Claude Code session over the last 24 hours. Identifies expensive sessions and highlights outliers that may warrant investigation for cost optimization.
panels.title: Cost Per Session (24h)

panels.description: Real-time per-second rate of uncached input tokens versus output tokens generated. Shows the balance between what's sent to the model (excluding cached content) and what's produced. Useful for understanding conversation dynamics and model verbosity.
panels.title: Input vs Output Token Rate (tokens/sec)

panels.description: Rolling 5-minute count of tool invocations by tool name, sourced from Claude Code logs. Shows which tools are used most frequently — useful for understanding agent behavior patterns and identifying over-reliance on specific tools.
panels.title: Tool Usage Frequency

panels.description: Total tool invocations by tool name over the selected period, sourced from Claude Code logs. Shows the overall tool mix — which tools Claude relied on most during the period.
panels.title: Tool Usage Distribution

panels.description: Percentage of successful tool invocations by tool name over rolling 15-minute windows. Sourced from Claude Code logs with JSON parsing. Tools below 100% indicate recurring errors — investigate failing tools for permission issues, misconfiguration, or flaky MCP connections.
panels.title: Tool Success Rate (%)

panels.description: Average API request duration in milliseconds broken down by Claude model, sourced from Claude Code logs. Shows model responsiveness over time — higher values indicate slower inference, larger responses, or network latency. Expect Opus > Sonnet > Haiku.
panels.title: API Response Time by Model (ms)

panels.description: Rate of API errors per second broken down by HTTP status code, sourced from Claude Code logs. 429 = rate limiting, 500/503 = server-side issues, 400 = malformed requests. Spikes indicate service degradation or usage hitting limits.
panels.title: API Error Rate by Status Code

panels.description: Live feed of Claude Code tool invocations with success/failure status, execution time, and error details. Use for real-time debugging and investigating failed tool calls.
panels.title: Tool Execution Log

panels.description: Live feed of Claude Code API errors with model, HTTP status code, duration, and error details. Use for diagnosing rate limiting, server-side failures, and request issues in real time
panels.title: API Error Log
